findings.summary: ball/cage: synthetic-only, uncalibrated amplitude. The ball and cage classes were trained on simulated faults whose mechanical amplitude (CALIBRATED_MECHANICAL_SEVERITY in datagen/scenario.py) is a placeholder: KAt has no clean single-defect code for these faults, so it cannot be calibrated without real data.
2048-sample (205 ms) windows: start-up transient accuracy 0.50; steady state 1.00 at 150 rad/s, 0.96 at 100 rad/s (cage recall 0.81).
Trained and evaluated on simulated data only. Recorded test accuracy 0.790; no real-machine validation exists.

The int8 TFLite export does not preserve this model: top-1 agreement with Keras 0.53 on the test split (accuracy 0.79 -> 0.43); calibrating on noise-free windows only did not help (0.52). Use the Keras/float model; int8 needs quantization-aware training.
